title: My friend and I decided to try Opus 5.5 and... wow
author: cringe_keys
selftext:
My friend and I cooked up a Rooftop Snipers x Super Smash Bros style game on Roblox mainly using Opus 5.5 High.

Initially, for the game I used GPT-5.6 Sol High on the Plus plan (this model did not do well with the game idea tbh), and then when Opus 5.5 came out and my friend tried it, it made our game SO MUCH BETTER.

Because of this, I cancelled my ChatGPT/Codex subscription and switched over to Claude (Pro plan) and we have been cooking with Opus 5.5 ever since.

Here is the link to the game (if you want to try it out): [https://www.roblox.com/games/115084549500488/ROOFTOP-RIOT](https://www.roblox.com/games/115084549500488/ROOFTOP-RIOT)

Feedback would be appreciated too. We started development on September 20th btw.

What do you guys think about Opus 5.5 so far?

comments.author: ArtificialImages
comments.body:
Just so you know chat.gpt codex is easily capable of this. 

Claude is doing some nice stuff right now. I'm seeing a lot that looks better than chats.

Looks fun!
